title: FLS tracker joins the crossing boat to wrong detections on most seeds
description: fls_170k_traffic full size: crossing boat (true 4.0 m/s) is a mover near its speed on only 2 of 7 seeds at either sound speed; otherwise fitted 6.7-18 m/s and classed line/uncertain/mover. Head-on boat fine on 14/14. Find why the track association fails (gate 1.5 m / 0.4 deg, wake 60 m astern?). STATUS 44.
notes: Cause found (RESULTS 'Why the tracker loses the crossing boat'): wake-climbing tracks (speed sigma 6 m/s) take the hull detection because association is nearest-gated-detection per track in list order. Likelihood-first (d2+ln|S|) fixes 7/7 seeds and cuts cluttered false movers 17->2, but rough-surface false movers 22->34. Hungarian neutral on rough surface. Proposal to owner pending: opt-in association option in both engines, default unchanged.
